reports.title: Early renders showed a new shared camera design
reports.summary: OnLeaks renders reported for the Galaxy S23 showed a redesigned camera treatment and a flat, rounded-edge handset.

reports.title: The S23 family might launch in a limited color range
reports.summary: A report citing display-industry insider Ross Young suggested Samsung could offer fewer launch colors across the S23 family.

reports.title: A full S23 family specification set leaked early
reports.summary: SamMobile reported leaked specifications for the Galaxy S23 family, including a newer chipset and a larger battery for the base model.

reports.title: The base S23 was tipped to gain a larger battery
reports.summary: A separate report said the smallest S23 could move to a 3,900mAh battery while using Snapdragon 8 Gen 2, rather than simply repeating the S22 capacity.

reports.title: Official-looking S23 family pictures appeared before launch
reports.summary: WinFuture images reported by Ars Technica showed the S23 family design and its camera changes shortly before Unpacked.
